name: No Entry Effect
description: Standard enemy entry with no special effects.

name: Junk Delivery
description: Enemy enters with a small junk pressure gift for the player to counter.
eventLogText: The enemy arrives with a snack tray full of junk!

name: Preview Glitter
description: Enemy blocks preview but gives a small grace period.
eventLogText: The enemy sparkles, hiding your preview!

name: Frost Warning
description: Enemy brings frost but warns you first.
eventLogText: The enemy chills the air around your block!

name: Ceiling Dip
description: Enemy makes the ceiling lower but gives time to react.
eventLogText: The enemy squeezes into the room, lowering the ceiling!

name: Floor Wobble
description: Enemy speeds up the floor slightly with warning.
eventLogText: The enemy's energy makes the floor speed up!

name: Royal Demand
description: Boss or elite demands a proper pattern with generous warning.
eventLogText: The royal enemy demands proper block etiquette!
